name: Raghab
headline:
Clean interfaces.
Robust algorithms.
Next-gen systems.
bio:
I am a 3rd-year B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at the Institute of Technology with a strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems, and Modern Full-Stack Engineering.

I combine analytical problem solving (350+ LeetCode problems solved) with an eye for fluid, human-centered UI design. Currently focused on building edge-computed web applications, modular component architectures, and scalable developer tools.

projects.title: Campus Connect
projects.description: A high-performance campus collaboration hub with real-time event streaming, role-based student access, and relational database schemas designed for 10,000+ university users.
projects.challenge: Campus organizations struggled with fragmented communication across scattered group chats, lost club announcements, and severe server latency during peak university registration events.
projects.approach: Designed a clean event-driven architecture using Next.js, Cloudflare Workers, and WebSocket channels for sub-100ms real-time broadcast and optimistic UI state caching.

projects.title: Everyday Studio
projects.description: A focused daily productivity engine featuring custom streak-tracking algorithms, offline-first local storage sync, and sub-16ms render loop interactions.
projects.challenge: Most habit trackers resemble dreary spreadsheets, lose streak accuracy across varying time zones, and stall when network signals drop on commuter trains.
projects.approach: Formulated a time-zone invariant streak algorithm backed by SQLite/IndexedDB offline replication, rendering fluid 60fps micro-animations for each check-in.

projects.title: Personal Playground
projects.description: An interactive WebGL & Canvas physics simulation environment exploring spring dynamics, particle collisions, and custom mathematical easing curves.
projects.challenge: Browser physics engines often buckle under heavy particle loads, causing skipped frames and jittery visual feedback during complex multi-body collisions.
projects.approach: Programmed a custom lightweight Verlet integration pipeline with spatial hashing for O(N log N) collision queries, completely written from scratch in TypeScript.

education.detail: CGPA: 9.2/10.0. Core Courses: Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming (Java/C++), Database Management Systems (DBMS), Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Discrete Mathematics.

principles.title: Start with the why
principles.body: Before writing a line of code or picking a database, I drill into what problem we are actually solving. Clean engineering begins with better questions, not premature abstractions.

principles.title: Design for a bad day
principles.body: Nobody uses software on pristine fiber optic with zero distractions. I engineer for spotty 4G, throttled CPUs, and confusing empty states. That's where quality shows.

principles.title: Build with the team
principles.body: The best systems come from teammates poking holes early in whiteboard designs. Clear documentation, strict type contracts, and humble collaboration always beat isolated code.
